# = NULL matches rows where the field is NULL
nickname = NULL

# != NULL matches the rest
nickname != NULL

# != keeps NULL rows
active != TRUE

# = never matches NULL rows
active = FALSE

# > never matches NULL rows, and age is NULL only for Mo
age > 0

# != on a joined field keeps rows with no country
country != 'France'

# ... unless NULLs are excluded explicitly
country != 'France' AND country != NULL

# = NULL on a joined field: no country
country = NULL

# A lateral field is NULL when the person has no order
last_order_at = NULL

# The aggregate count is never NULL
order_count = NULL

# = NULL on a field that is not nullable is accepted and matches nothing
name = NULL

# EXCLUDES on scalar text matches NULL rows too
nickname EXCLUDES 'e'

# The keyword NULL is case-insensitive
due = null
